about_the_game:
Official Lorebook ~Book of the Life~
(Available in both English & Korean | Digital only)

Step beyond the game and dive deeper into the archives of Eclipse.
The official Digital Lorebook DLC is packed with exclusive content, perfect for Eclipse Agents who want to explore the world, the characters, the creative process, and the secrets behind the game.

🌑 Highlights

  • Includes two short stories exclusive to the Lorebook

  • Never-before-seen concept art

  • Behind-the-Scenes Commentary by the Dev Team

  • A complete guide to the Eclipse universe: history, nations, and secrets

📖 Contents Table

  • The Characters

  • The Behind Story I

  • The World

  • The Nations

  • The Timeline

  • The Flow Chart

  • The Behind Story II

  • Artwork

⚠️ Important Notes

  • Provided digitally only (no physical shipping required)

  • Available in both English and Korean

  • Redistribution, transfer, or resale of the Digital Lorebook is strictly prohibited and considered illegal

kgrb.descriptors:
등급 번호: GC-CC-NP-240628-001
등급: 15세 이용가

평화를 지키기 위해 이단 종교 집단 ‘아펩’에 맞서 싸우는 특수부대 ‘이클립스’의 대원이 겪는 이야기를 다룬 PC용 비주얼 노벨 게임

제한적인 폭력성 표현
(폭력적인 상황에 대한 언어적 묘사와 일러스트, 붉은 선혈 표현)

과도하지 않은 언어 표현
(등장인물의 일부 비속어 표현)

따라서 게임산업진흥에 관한 법률 제21조 및 등급분류 규정 제7조제3호에 따라 ‘15세이용가’로 등급분류 결정함.
